xhk.jpg.giveaway: Reads as real. Heavy codec softness and macroblocking in the dark field, a grey environmental band and faint lit structure at the top edge, and a real background that is not pure black. The frosting has real, uneven, lumpy texture with crumbs and drag marks; the rim is a soft, irregular hand-spread lip rather than a modelled bead. Candles are uneven in height and lean at different angles, two are red/white spirals with wax showing real translucency and dribble, the others are plain cream. Flames are small, tear-shaped and slightly smeared with a soft halo; the cake top shows no hard light pools. Lettering is thin piped red gel sitting slightly in the surface. Sides fall off into shadow with no visible polka-dot holes, just faint dark flecks. Exposure is low-key with crushed blacks and natural vignetting.

qxt.jpg.giveaway: Reads as real. Wide, low angle with the cake small in frame on a softly lit square table/board with a gradual light falloff, a dark wall band and faint lighter strip at frame top. Strong compression blur and banding; the candles cluster together near the back, uneven in height, mixed yellow and striped, flames soft and blooming with a faint smoke/heat haze above. Frosting is rough and lumpy with irregular dark flecks; a thin foil cake board visible at base. Only doubt: so blurry that fine material cues cannot be checked.

qxc.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Same three-quarter overhead camera and cake model as mmf/bqy/oyb/htd/ugy. Background is a clean, noise-free near-black gradient with no environment. The top is a uniform yellow-green flat disc lit like a single soft area light; the frosting has a procedural micro-ripple rather than spread strokes. Edge bead is a regular, scalloped extruded ring, and the cake board ring at the base is a second identical scallop that glows with the same rim light. Sides carry evenly spaced round black 'holes' that read as punctures, not chocolate chips or flecks. Candles are straight CG cylinders all perfectly vertical, with uniform thickness and crisp sharp silhouettes; flames are identical bright teardrops with a faint additive glow and no bloom on the frosting around them. Lettering is better (red, piped) but sits on top like decals. No grain, no compression blocking, no depth-of-field.

htd.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Same overhead model. Candles all clustered to the right-back and perfectly vertical; two stripy candles share near-identical stripe pitch. Top surface has a regular wavy displacement pattern visible across the whole disc (looks like noise texture, not knife strokes). Lettering is four separated pinkish blobs, orange-pink and too saturated, sitting on top. Side holes are spaced like a dot pattern; scalloped base ring is a duplicate of the top bead. Light: even fill across the top with a centre hotspot; sides fall off too smoothly. Clean black void, no grain, no table.

nfi.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Front-on cake with a table plane and warm spill, which helps, but the table ends in a perfectly straight, hard horizontal edge to pure black, and the floor below is flat featureless black. The cake sits floating with no contact shadow under the board; the board is a smooth glowing ring. Cake sides are a flat, uniform caramel-brown, smoother and darker than the top, with sparse black dots like holes. The top bead is a neat regular ragged ribbon. Candles: very thin, straight, evenly lit, flames have a large soft circular halo (additive sprite) that looks like lens bloom pasted on. Lettering is orange blobs in a straight line. Light on the table is a smooth radial gradient centred under the cake, as if from a spotlight in the cake, not from candles above.

mmf.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Overhead model. Two candles overlap at upper left (one standing in front of another at the same x), which reads as a placement collision. All candles perfectly vertical and of identical diameter; each has a modelled cone of wax at its base like a cup. Top is a flat pale yellow-green with no tooling marks, a darker band near the rim where a fake AO is applied. Lettering is orange lumpy blobs. Sides have large black circular holes of varying size and a horizontal ridged texture like lathe rings. Base scallop and top bead are the same repeated geometry. Pure black, noiseless background.

sld.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Same front-on scene as nfi. One candle stands in the middle of the lettering and another is placed on the near front edge, making the arrangement look random rather than planted. Candles vary only in height, all perfectly vertical, thin and crisp. Lettering is a single smeared orange bar. Side texture is a fine regular noise with sparse black holes. Hard horizontal table edge to black; no contact shadow; radial spotlight-like pool on the table; floating feel. No grain.

ugy.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Overhead model. Lettering is four orange crumbly clumps that do not read as characters. Candles spread in a rough circle, perfectly vertical with crisp silhouettes; two striped candles with candy-cane stripes of identical pitch. Sides have big black holes, including some on the near side that look like bullet holes; base scallop repeats top bead. Top is flat yellow-green with a visible bright hotspot behind the candles. Black void, no grain, no camera artefacts.

oyb.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Overhead model. Lettering runs diagonally down the top as a vertical stack of orange clumps, not a horizontal line of piped characters. Candles bunched toward the back, all vertical, uniform diameter, flames identical. Top has a darker saturated yellow-green; bead and base scallop are the same regular geometry. Side holes evenly sprinkled. Clean black background with a faint additive glow around the flame cluster.

bqy.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Overhead model. Lettering is a long orange-red smear like a sausage of beads, too large and saturated. Candles: six lined in a near-straight arc across the back, one off on its own at the right edge; all perfectly vertical with identical flames. Side holes in clusters, some large and irregular, read as damage. Top flat pale green-yellow with fake rim darkening; base scallop identical to top bead. Black void, no grain.
